notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 32 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 65,536 B/token (64.0 KiB). head_dim 128 and num_key_value_heads 4 are explicit in config.json; uniform full attention, no sliding window; max_position_embeddings 262144 native, no rope_scaling in the config. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card publishes general reasoning and deep-search tables; all 9 rows match exactly.
